title: Rheology Data of Dowsil EI-1184

resources.description:
All measurements taken with Modular Compact Series of Anton Paar AG rheometer at Institut für Transport- und Automatisierungstechnik (ITA) of the Leibniz Universität Hannover (LUH).

All measurements taken by Lennart Mesecke @IPeG under supervision of Tobias Biermann @IPeG.

All measurements taken at roomtemperature R_T=20°C.

Dataset contains:

DOWSIL-EI1184-Rheology-Viscosity-00min to 90min => Rotational measurements to determine viscosity at different timepoints (00 to 90min) for understanding curing behaviour of the two component material.

DOWSIL-El1184-Rheology-Oscillatory-00min => Oscillatory measurements at 00min curing time for determining storage and loss modulus.
